question: What kind of events or programs does ERICA offer to support international students?
required_facts: Field programs to attractions and traditional culture (1-2 per semester; apply at the OIA Welcome Desk)
Free K-Movie Night with English subtitles (1-2 per semester)
Hanmille peer mentoring program for new international students
GLOBAL LOVE HYU student group; also the 3-phase counseling service
reference_answer: ERICA's OIA runs field programs to attractions and traditional-culture sites (1-2 a semester; sign up at the Welcome Desk in front of the OIA), a free K-Movie Night with English subtitles (1-2 a semester), the Hanmille peer-mentoring program that pairs new international students with current students, and the GLOBAL LOVE HYU student group, whose members can receive up to KRW 1,000,000 in scholarship. Free psychological counseling is also available.

question: Can you explain the group visa application process?
required_facts: Seoul: applying in person is the rule, but the OIA offers group visa (D-4->D-2 change, D-2 extension) and group residence-card applications

Seoul: from abroad, get the Certificate of Admission (overseas use), get the D-2 at the embassy, enter, then apply for the group residence card; in Korea, use the domestic-use certificate and the group visa (change mid-Aug, extension mid-Aug to mid-Sep)
ERICA: group registrations are announced in OIA notices each semester (guide as attachment); otherwise book on HiKorea and apply individually
reference_answer: It depends on your campus. At ERICA, group registrations are announced in the OIA notices each semester (the guide is an attachment the snapshot cannot read); otherwise book on HiKorea and apply at the immigration office yourself. At Seoul, applying in person is the rule, but the OIA runs group applications: if you are abroad, get the overseas-use Certificate of Admission, obtain the D-2 at the embassy, enter Korea and join the group residence-card application; if you are in Korea, use the domestic-use certificate and join the group visa application (change mid-August, extension mid-August to mid-September).
notes: Campus unstated (persona ERICA). ERICA's 2025 group visa guide is attachment-only (11.2), so the ERICA branch gives only the notice route. Verified: two campus values -> conditional_answer (11.6).

question: Do I need to buy the university insurance?
required_facts: ERICA, completed coursework: you must subscribe to the university group insurance individually through the insurance company's website
ERICA, enrolled: the KRW 25,000 premium is on the tuition bill and must be paid with tuition
Seoul: enrolled students' premiums are paid by the university; completed-coursework students who want it pay 25,000 won themselves
National Health Insurance is a separate policy from the university group insurance
reference_answer: Which campus are you at, and are you enrolled or have you completed coursework? (For you at ERICA with completed coursework: yes, you must subscribe to the university group insurance yourself through the insurance company's website; the premium is KRW 25,000, and National Health Insurance is a separate policy.)
notes: Campus and academic_status both unstated; four different answers (ERICA: tuition bill / individual; Seoul: university pays / optional 25,000) -> clarify (11.6). Hard: which attribute to ask first. Verified: Seoul spans moved to gold with branch marks (11.5).

question: What is the tuition fee per semester for international undergraduates?
required_facts: The English pages do not state the tuition amount per semester
Admitted students can view their tuition bill in the Admission Information section of the admission result page
reference_answer: The official English pages in the snapshot do not state the undergraduate tuition amount per semester; admitted students see it on the tuition bill printed from the admission result page. Please check the undergraduate admission guide or ask the International Admission Team.

question: When does the GKS-G application open this year?
required_facts: 2026 GKS-G (university track at Hanyang): application period February 11, 2026 10:00 - March 3, 2026 17:00 KST
Applications outside the period are not accepted; apply via the online form and submit documents within the period
reference_answer: For 2026, Hanyang's GKS-G (university track) applications opened on February 11, 2026 at 10:00 and closed on March 3, 2026 at 17:00 KST; late applications are not accepted. That window has already closed for this year.
